artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\geq 1$ and let $S^n$ denote the standard $n$-sphere. Consider the cotangent bundle $T^*S^n$ with its canonical symplectic structure, and let $W\subset T^*S^n$ be a fiber-wise convex domain (i.e., for each $q\in S^n$ the fiber $W\cap T^*_qS^n$ is a convex set containing the origin). A homeomorphism $f:W\to W$ is called a $C^0$-Hamiltonian self-map of $W$ if it is the $C^0$-limit (uniform limit) of time-one maps of compactly supported smooth Hamiltonian isotopies of $W$.

A convex billiard table is a smooth, strictly convex bounded domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ (with smooth boundary $\partial\Omega$). Its associated billiard map $B_\Omega$ acts on the set of unit tangent vectors based on $\partial\Omega$ pointing inward, sending an inward unit vector $(q,v)$ to $(q',v')$ where $q'$ is the next intersection of the trajectory $q+tv$ with $\partial\Omega$ and $v'$ is the reflection of $v$ across $T_{q'}\partial\Omega$. After identification (via the Gauss map and the Legendre/Lagrangian correspondence) the billiard map can be viewed as a $C^0$-Hamiltonian self-map of a fiber-wise convex domain in $T^*S^n$.

Problem: Give an intrinsic characterization of those $C^0$-Hamiltonian self-maps $f:W\to W$ of a fiber-wise convex domain $W\subset T^*S^n$ which arise (under the above identification) as billiard maps of convex billiard tables in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$. Resolve this in particular in the case $n=1$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as open by its proposer, who notes that even the case $n=1$ is open. No published characterization of billiard maps among $C^0$-Hamiltonian self-maps of fiber-wise convex domains in $T^*S^n$ appears to be known.
